en.html:
The plan was disgracefully rough.

—Infiltrate as far as possible. Thereafter, assault.

Finished.

An operation? Two verbs cannot carry that much dignity. But the operatives were Ichijou and myself, not assassination specialists, and the deadline was both uncertain and very near. Under those conditions, where was a proper plan to come from?

Andar ghuso. Go inside. Then? Maaro. Attack. A third thought would merely delay these two very energetic thoughts. The entire operation could fit in one mouthful, and still leave room for the sigh afterward.

Uncertain and near meant: before the Oyumi shogunate army finished preparing to attack Prince Maidono. For two warriors to attack an army already on the move and kill its commander—think it through, impossible. Without thinking, also impossible.

While Raichou Imagawa remained at Oyumi's Kubo headquarters: that was our only opportunity.

...No. Even then, could we? A proper military installation, now packed with a great army. How difficult would an assault become?

Still, a sudden mobilisation must have thrown headquarters into considerable confusion. Confusion should leave an opening.

—There, and nowhere else, was something to stake our hope on.

計画は酷く杜撰である。
　
　――潜入できるところまで潜入し、<ruby>然<rt>しか</rt></ruby>るのち強襲。
以上。

　作戦と呼ぶようなものではない。
　が、実行者が暗殺の専門家に<ruby>非<rt>あら</rt></ruby>ざる俺と一条、時間
制限が詳細不明ながら至近、という条件ではまともな
作戦などそもそも立てようもなかった。

　時間制限が不明にして至近とはつまり、小弓幕軍が
舞殿宮攻撃の準備を終える前に……という意味である。
　作戦行動中の軍隊を二騎で襲撃して主将を討ち取る
のはどう考えても、いや考えなくても無理だからだ。

　今川雷蝶が小弓の公方府に留まっている間しか<ruby>機会<rt>チャンス</rt></ruby>
は無い。……否。それでもどうか、と思う。
　公方府は歴とした軍事施設であり、しかも今は大軍
が詰める。襲撃の困難は如何程になろう。

　だが急な軍の召集は公方府に少なからぬ混乱を生じ
させている筈。ならば隙もあるに違いない。
　
　――そこが唯一、望みを懸けられる点だった。

en.html: The odds were poor. Perhaps worse than at Fudaraku, where, considered as an operation, our operation had been a magnificent failure. Yet the feeling of danger was not there. Some almost prophetic certainty told me this hopeless plan would succeed...◆no, nothing of the kind. That mental anesthesia was not available with me. How little chance we had, I understood. Still, the desperate hurry would not come. Think of what failure meant for Ichijou, the prince and his people, myself—then yes. Plenty of fear. Plenty of hurry. But failing to assassinate Raichou Imagawa? That failure, by itself, did not disturb me. Rather—if it ended that way, perhaps better only...
en.text:
The odds were poor. Perhaps worse than at Fudaraku, where, considered as an operation, our operation had been a magnificent failure.

Yet the feeling of danger was not there. Some almost prophetic certainty told me this hopeless plan would succeed...◆no, nothing of the kind. That mental anesthesia was not available with me.

How little chance we had, I understood. Still, the desperate hurry would not come. Think of what failure meant for Ichijou, the prince and his people, myself—then yes. Plenty of fear. Plenty of hurry.

But failing to assassinate Raichou Imagawa? That failure, by itself, did not disturb me.

Rather—if it ended that way, perhaps better only...

Kageaki"..."
Ichijou"..."
Kageaki"A man being used as a windbreak by a young lady, in broad daylight. How does this look to other people?"
Ichijou"Very comfortable. If I saw such a fellow, I'd kick him into the sea."
Kageaki"That is death by freezing, very straightforward. Please give me some room."
Ichijou"Arre, relax. I'm not the one watching from outside today."
Kageaki"You are occupying the outside. I cannot move properly."
Ichijou"Broad daylight. On a boat. Where are you planning to go?"
Kageaki"Nowhere. But going nowhere by choice and being unable to go anywhere—these are different conditions."
Ichijou"...Minato sir. Even doing nothing, you need it done your way?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Ichijou"Why so proud of this admission?"
Kageaki"False hopes about my own character, I do not keep."
Ichijou"That much I've understood... very thoroughly..."

I pulled the edge of my coat farther, sheltering Ichijou's head as well.

en.html:
—That victory itself was my difficulty.

This, I could not tell her.

The girl was beautiful. An innocent belief, and a person giving her whole self to it. So much light could come from that.

Dazzling, I thought.
Something precious.

Even now, that feeling had not changed.

The very ideal I had let go of—here she was.

Then why could I not simply disappear into this light?

Why was I stopping?

In today's Yamato, those with armed power did whatever they pleased. Oppress the weak, exploit them. And this girl alone was standing on the other side, using that same power to challenge the arrogant strong.

See justice there. Accept it. Become part of it.

...Just before that last step, I stopped. Why?

What was troubling me so much? Something behind the light she gave off...

Something the brightness itself was keeping me from seeing.

In shadow, its nature unknown. Then why could I not leave it alone?

Why————

――その<ruby>勝利<rt>・・</rt></ruby>にこそ俺の不安があるのだ。
　とは、口にできなかった。

　少女は美しい。
　無垢の信念を有し、そのために身魂を捧げた人間と
いうものは、こうまでも輝く。

　眩しいと感ずる。
　尊いと思う。
　
　やはり、その思いは今でも変わらない。

　この少女は俺が手放してしまった<ruby>理想<rt>ゆめ</rt></ruby>そのものだ。

　だというのに、何故――
　俺はこの光輝の中に埋没できないのだろう。

　何故、踏み<ruby>止<rt>とど</rt></ruby>まってしまうのか。

　<ruby>武力<rt>ちから</rt></ruby>ある者達が悉く<ruby>欲儘<rt>ほしいまま</rt></ruby>に振舞い、弱者を虐げ搾取
するこの現代大和で、唯一、弱者の側に立って武力を
揮い不遜な強者に挑もうとする少女――
　そこに正義を認め。服し。一部となる、

　……その一歩手前で。
　どうして俺は踏み止まってしまうのか。

　何故、こんなにも気に掛かるのだろう。
　少女の放つ光の奥にあるもの……

　この輝きに<ruby>眩<rt>くら</rt></ruby>まされてしまっている<ruby>何か<rt>・・</rt></ruby>。
　陰に隠れ、正体の知れないそれが、どうしてこうも
引っ掛かるのか。

　どうして――――

en.html:
A local police officer in contact with the Chief had sent word. Oyumi's military district was preparing for full-scale war, under martial law in everything but name. Main roads already closed, he said.

Above us, of course, dragoon patrols. Roads shut, sky patrolled, but the sea—please come freely? Not likely. Raichou Imagawa had probably put everything on alert against a first strike.

...Even overreaction should have some limit. But I knew what the prince's side actually had. Without that knowledge, what could I say? From the Oyumi Kubo's side, these were surely ordinary precautions.

ば、小弓軍管区は本格的な戦争に備えた事実上の戒厳

Kageaki"Nearly the whole Bousou Peninsula is under Oyumi's army. Better to assume every port is closed to us. We get off at Urayasu."
Kageaki"From there, bus to Funabashi. After that, our feet. A little more time, but least noticeable, and we can change direction easily."
Ichijou"Armour on, fly straight there. If only we could. Kitna easy."
Kageaki"Enter Oyumi airspace and they detect us immediately. By headquarters, we would be surrounded completely."
